entities.summary: Marie Louise Thomsen née Molbech (1823–1907) was a pioneering Danish photographer who ran a photographic business in Hellebæk in the north of Zealand from the early 1860s. Many of the photographs she took in the area near her home have been preserved and are published in Jesper Godvin Hansen's Fotografen Louise Thomsen 1823–1907.
